design: Test whether a brief load transfer restores single-foot support in the two early-stalled right-turn worlds. Use archived successful early joint targets to derive direction and confirm the target projection on CPU before sampling.

candidate_guardrails.physical_action_and_joint_envelope: Use the unchanged walking projection and preserve issued raw policy history. Freeze exact affected joints, signs, waveform and rejection conditions after CPU readback.

possible_development_screen.mechanism_gate: At least one intended world must establish continuous same-foot support for 0.10 seconds by 3 seconds while its reference does not. No deterioration in original joint limits, tilt, survival or contact slip. Require actual direction and size of lateral motion; do not score replay as physical recovery.
possible_development_screen.continuation_gate: Only after the mechanism gate passes, freeze a separate full 20-second seven-command evaluation with the original forward/backward regression and safety gates before using a fresh development seed.
